elements.label: 3D character (Oscar) in the chair, shrinking in frame as the camera snaps out
Interviewer's microphone and hand entering at the left edge as the frame widens

pattern.description: A fast snap pull-out (about 0.80x scale over about 4 frames) from a close-up of the character to a medium shot that reveals the interviewer's mic at the left edge, landing on 'some big' in the narration.
pattern.why_premium: Abrupt sitcom-style zoom cuts set comic rhythm without a hard cut, and the reveal of the off-screen mic adds context in the same move.

build_hint.gsap: Camera container starts scaled: gsap.fromTo(camera, {scale: 1.25}, {scale: 1, duration: 0.13, ease: 'expo.out', transformOrigin: '50% 40%'}); the mic layer sits outside the initial crop so it enters naturally as the scale drops.
build_hint.remotion: scale = interpolate(frame, [start, start + 4], [1.25, 1], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.exp), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) on an AbsoluteFill wrapper; no spring (no overshoot visible).

notes: Camera verdict pull_out (scale 0.80); the motion is almost all camera. Most diff boxes (b03, b05-b09) are curtain-fold slivers and are not listed. b04 is the closest box for the mic; it is a column strip, not a tight box. No SFX candidates.
